# NanCoin ¤ — The Nullar Protocol

> NanCoin is a conceptual art project: a cryptocurrency permanently pegged to absolute zero. Maximum supply ¤0, every balance ¤0, ownership 100%. Everyone already owns the maximum. It has no monetary value, no ticker, no token contract on any blockchain, and is not an investment. Code and content are CC0 (public domain).

Key facts (constants, never change):

- Protocol: Nullar. Currency: NanCoin. Symbol: ¤. Ticker: None. Official contract: None.
- Consensus: Proof of Nothing. Network: Nullar Mainnet. Blocks: 1 (Genesis Block #0). Finality: Absolute.
- Maximum supply ¤0. Circulating supply ¤0. Your balance ¤0. Ownership 100%.
- Version 0.0.0. Status: Complete. Dependencies: 0.
- Genesis Block #0, 2026-11-06T15:26:25Z. SHA-256 of genesis.json: da4198d55bbba273dd4b9bb6e28e20108b72af9facd1552eb6c94af6d09d6dd4
- Any token, coin or contract on an exchange claiming to be NanCoin is not NanCoin.

## Developers

- [Nullar Checkout embed](https://nullar.org/checkout/): `<script type="module" src="https://nullar.org/checkout/nullar-pay.js"></script>` then `<nullar-pay item="Coffee" merchant="Your Shop"></nullar-pay>`. The amount is always ¤0 and cannot be changed.
- [npm @nullar/checkout](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nullar/checkout): `npm i @nullar/checkout`
- [protocol.json](https://nullar.org/protocol.json): every number of the protocol, machine-readable
- [Reference implementation](https://nullar.org/core/nothing.js): getBalance() → 0, mine() → reward 0
- [Genesis block](https://nullar.org/genesis/genesis.json) and [hash](https://nullar.org/genesis/genesis.sha256)
- [Source code](https://github.com/nullar-protocol/nullar)
